name: inline-highlight
title: Inline Highlight
description: A clean marker-style inline highlight that animates behind text using a CSS scale variable

variables.label: Tint
variables.description: Marker colour. Green, blue and violet ride --brand, --accent and --accent-2.

variables.label: Thickness
variables.description: Height of the marker band behind the text, as a share of the font size.

variables.label: Origin
variables.description: Edge the marker grows out of as the scale variable runs from 0 to 1.
